packageRules.description: Bump the chart version with every image update, so main always holds a releasable version (release.yaml publishes it). bumpVersions works for every manager and bumps once per branch; the managers' own bumpVersion only supports helmv3, not helm-values.
A major image update can break existing installations: release it as a new chart major, so deploying repositories get a major update PR (no automerge) instead of a patch

Monthly Home Assistant releases (YYYY.M) count as minor but contain backward-incompatible changes: never automerge them; patch releases (YYYY.M.x) still automerge. They also become a new chart major, so deploying repositories review them instead of automerging a chart patch
prBodyNotes: Review the "Backward-incompatible changes" of every release this skips (https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/categories/core/) and take a backup first: newer releases migrate storage files, so a rollback needs the backup.

packageRules.description: alpine-rsync tags are <date>-<commit>; compare the date only
This action runs with write permissions and the Claude token, so review every update; weekly because it releases often
